verdict.rationale: Galileo documents Experiments that evaluate prompts, models, and app code against well-defined inputs, including a sample dataset and sample prompt. It also supports datasets built from synthetic and development data. Together these give an offline testing path separate from live production logging, but the evidence never describes a dedicated sandbox environment or explicit isolation from production data. missing for 10: an explicit sandbox or test-environment feature, documented separation or isolation of production data, independent or hands-on corroboration
